description: This Java source file defines the 'MainActivity' class for an Android application. It sets up the main user interface, manages fragment transactions, handles menu interactions to toggle the logging view, and initializes logging mechanisms with custom log wrappers and filters.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity for the app, managing the UI, fragments, menus, and logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the ScreenCaptureFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from menu resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, toggling the visibility and title of the log toggle menu item based on app state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, specifically toggling the log view.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging chain with wrappers, filters, and a log fragment for on-screen display.
